text.en:
Mon. Efren Plana
Undersecretary of National Defense . . Member
Special Assistant to the
Executive Secretary .
The Peaco and Order Coordinating Coucil shall
serve as the Secretariat of the Committee.
IN WITNESS VERBOR, I have hereunto set my
hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Phi-
lippines to be affixed.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this
26th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nine-
teen hundred and seventy-one,
(SGD.) FERDINAND B. MARCOS
President of the Fhilippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
